note: Every measurement below came from an artifact retrieved on 2026-09-21. Sources that could not be retrieved are marked retrieved:false and carry no field claims.

workingDefinition.statement: Transmission headroom is the signed MW by which flow across a specific monitored element or interface, in a specific direction, under a specific contingency assumption, differs from the limit the operator was enforcing at that moment.

feasibilityClasses.A: source exposes a defensible headroom metric directly
feasibilityClasses.B: source exposes compatible flow and limit allowing calculation
feasibilityClasses.C: only a capability or limit proxy is public
feasibilityClasses.D: public data cannot support a defensible headroom metric

markets.sourceName: NYISO Market Information System — External Limits and Flows
markets.contingencyNote: Interface limits are all-in operating limits that already embed contingency analysis; they cannot be decomposed into pre- and post-contingency.

traps.detail: 9999 and -9999 mean unmonitored in that direction, not a limit. headroom = 1273.04 - (-9999) would fabricate 11272 MW on CENTRAL EAST. Six interfaces carry -9999; WEST CENTRAL carries +9999.
In 2005 every row carried unsigned 9999 in BOTH limit columns. The signed -9999 convention appears by 2010.
CENTRAL EAST carried both 2690 and 2740 within one day; UPNY CONED 5680 and 5800; SCH - HQ - NY negative limit -100 and -985. No static rating table is valid.
2005 had 365 irregular stamps per day; 2010 onward is a clean 288 x 5 minutes.
11 interfaces in 2005 to 19 in 2026. SCH - HQ_CHPE (Point ID 625211) is recently energized. Identity must be Point ID, never name.
SCH - HQ_CEDARS has limits 49/0 and flow 0.0 all day. Arithmetic headroom exists but the tie is not carrying. Needs a state, not a number.
SCH - PJM_NEPTUNE sat at exactly 660.0 against a 660 limit for every interval. Headroom 0.0 is a correct observation and must not render as missing.

rights.decisiveWording: Access to this Web site does not confer any license or ownership interest in either the form or content of the Web site.
rights.note: No affirmative reuse grant and no explicit prohibition on CSV data. The image/video reproduction prohibition is specific to images and video. Must be recorded independently of the NYISO Interconnection Queue determination.

markets.sourceName: ERCOT SCED Shadow Prices and Binding Transmission Constraints (NP6-86-CD)

traps.detail: Only constraints SCED was actively managing appear. 30 constraints out of thousands of elements. An element with abundant headroom never appears, so the denominator is invisible and this cannot answer 'how much headroom does ERCOT have'.
ViolatedMW equals -(Limit - Value) to within 0.1 MW; 52 of 332 rows differ by rounding only.
NONCOMP on every observed row; vocabulary unresolved.
Base-case constraints such as NELRIO carry empty FromStation/ToStation and 0 kV.

markets.acquisitionNote: doclookupId values are opaque and must be scraped from a rolling HTML listing. Long history needs continuous capture or the ERCOT archive product. The IQ-3 ERCOT reader already handles this listing idiom.

rights.note: Must be determined independently of the ERCOT Generator Interconnection Status Report determination.

reasons: ATC exceeds TTC in 27.7% of direction-intervals, so ATC = TTC - TRM - CBM - usage is not merely inexact but impossible.
USEAGE_MW is 0 in 100% of rows, so no flow term exists and limit - flow is not derivable.
74.5% export/import residual antisymmetry shows ATC nets counterflow: ADLANTO-SP_ITC export residual -309.0 against import residual +309.0.
ATC answers 'how much more could be scheduled', not 'how far is flow from the limit'.

markets.th2Exclusion: Public data is capability, not headroom. Publishing ATC as headroom is the single most likely way to get this product wrong.

traps.detail: Source Limit 70, Real Time Effective Limit 63.7, Initial Effective Limit 67.9 on the same constraint in the same interval. Choosing wrong is a 9% error. The limit field used must be first-class, not a convention.
No flow column, so limit - flow is not derivable.

crossMarket.reason: The quantities are different objects, not differently measured versions of one object. NYISO is a margin on 19 named interfaces against all-in operating limits; ERCOT is a distance-to-limit on whichever ~30 elements SCED was managing, per contingency; CAISO is capability net of counterflow with no flow term; SPP publishes limits with no flow; MISO publishes neither.
crossMarket.constrainedCountReason: ERCOT and SPP denominators are the binding subset; NYISO's is a fixed roster of 19. The denominators are incompatible.
crossMarket.whatTravels: The shape of the finding, not the magnitude. 'This interface is at its limit' is comparable; 'this market has N MW of headroom' is not.

candidateV1Metrics.condition: direction-matched limit, never when the limit is a sentinel

candidateV1Metrics.reason: no planning source retrieved in any market

entityModelRecommendation.reason: Different identity sources, different limit semantics, different directional meaning. One generalized table would force a lowest-common-denominator schema and lose the distinctions that make the product defensible.

proposedEntities.name: transmission_margin
proposedEntities.onlyWhen: both a limit and a flow exist for the same entity, direction, contingency and interval

entityModelRecommendation.identityRule: Source-native stable IDs only. Never name similarity.

hardInvariants: a sentinel limit (+/-9999) is unmonitored, never a number
headroom is signed and is never clamped at zero
utilization is computed only against a direction-matched, non-sentinel limit
every derived margin records which published limit field it used

recommendedTh2.rationale: NYISO is the only source publishing flow and a directional limit together as a standing series, with no auth, a stable schema since 2010, a numeric Point ID and roughly two decades of monthly archives. ERCOT publishes genuine limit/flow pairs with explicit contingency naming and a clean source-backed binding indicator, and the IQ-3 ERCOT reader already solves its listing idiom.
scope: canonical foundation with transmission_interface and transmission_element separate
limit and flow observations joined into a margin only where both exist at the same grain
sentinel handling enforced in the database
NYISO ingestion, current plus monthly archive backfill, with the 2005-era convention detected and handled as a separate schema
ERCOT NP6-86-CD ingestion, forward-only, labelled explicitly as the binding subset
no frontend, no public API, no cross-market metric
recommendedTh2.precondition: Rights review for the NYISO MIS interface and the ERCOT MIS interface must be completed and recorded before TH-2 ingestion, not alongside it.

anchors.spp: Monitored Facility and Contingent Facility free text, a State column, NERCID, and a separate unexamined ArcGIS service at pricecontourmap.spp.org/arcgis/rest/services/MarketMaps/RTBM_FeatureData/MapServer
anchors.miso: branch names with from/to control areas

mapCompatibility.recommendation: Do not attempt geographic linking in TH-2. It requires resolving substation names to locations, the same class of problem the map phase solved for facilities, with the same name-similarity false-match risk.
